Vendora Developers
Developer API · v2

Build with the Vendora Vendor Network

Search thousands of pre-vetted, licensed and insured service vendors by location. Pass any address fragment + a radius and get ranked results instantly.

Address-aware search

Pass any address fragment — street, city, zip, or partial — and a radius in miles. We geocode it and return vendors sorted by proximity.

Pre-vetted vendors

Every vendor in the network is scored A–F based on licensing, insurance, BBB rating, reviews, and years in business.

Simple REST API

One endpoint, standard JSON, bearer token auth. Works with any language. Get results in under 500ms.

Quick example

Request

GET /v2/vendors ?address=123 Main St Newark NJ &radius=15 &category=PLB &limit=5
Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_key

Response

{ "total": 42, "radius_miles": 15, "search_center": { "lat": 40.7357, "lng": -74.1724 }, "vendors": [{ "canonical_name": "Joe's Plumbing", "score_tier": "A", "distance_miles": 3.2, "is_licensed": true, "primary_phone": "9735551234" }] }

API Reference


        
        

          
Base URL

          
http://45.77.79.14/v2

          
All requests must include a valid API key. The API returns JSON.

        


        
        

          
Authentication

          
Pass your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header, or as the api_key query parameter.

          
# Preferred: header
Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here

# Alternative: query param
GET /v2/vendors?api_key=vnd_your_api_key_here&address=...

        


        
        

          

            GET
            /v2/vendors
            — Search vendors by location
          

          

            
Query Parameters

            

              

                
                  

                    Parameter
                    Type
                    Required
                    Description
                  

                
                
                  

                    address
                    string
                    Yes
                    Any address fragment — street, city, zip, partial address. Geocoded automatically.
                  

                  

                    radius
                    number
                    No
                    Search radius in miles. Default: 25. Range: 1–200.
                  

                  

                    q
                    string
                    No
                    Keyword to match against business name.
                  

                  

                    category
                    string
                    No
                    Category code prefix. E.g. PLB (all plumbing) or PLB.GEN (general plumbing).
                  

                  

                    limit
                    number
                    No
                    Results per page. Default: 12. Max: 50.
                  

                  

                    page
                    number
                    No
                    Page number, 1-indexed. Default: 1.
                  

                
              

            

          

        


        
        

          

            
Response Schema

          

          

            
{
  "vendors": [
    {
      "vendor_id":              "uuid",
      "canonical_name":         "Joe's Plumbing LLC",
      "city":                   "Newark",
      "state":                  "NJ",
      "zip":                    "07102",
      "primary_phone":          "9735551234",
      "website_url":            "https://joesplumbing.com",
      "is_onboarded":          true,
      "is_licensed":           true,
      "is_insured":            true,
      "vendor_score":          84.5,
      "score_tier":            "A",
      "category_display_name":  "General Plumbing",
      "category_code":         "PLB.GEN",
      "distance_miles":        3.2   // null if not yet geocoded
    }
  ],
  "total":          127,
  "page":           1,
  "limit":          12,
  "radius_miles":   25,
  "search_center": {
    "lat": 40.7357,
    "lng": -74.1724,
    "formatted_address": "Newark, Essex County, NJ, USA"
  }
}

          

        


        
        

          

            
Code Examples

          

          

            
            

              
              
              
            

            
curl -X GET \
  "http://45.77.79.14/v2/vendors?address=123+Main+St+Newark+NJ&radius=25&category=PLB" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here"

            
const res = await fetch(
  'http://45.77.79.14/v2/vendors?' + new URLSearchParams({
    address:  '123 Main St Newark NJ',
    radius:   25,
    category: 'PLB',
    limit:    10,
  }),
  { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here' } }
);
const { vendors, total, search_center } = await res.json();
console.log(`Found ${total} vendors near ${search_center.formatted_address}`);

            
import requests

resp = requests.get(
    'http://45.77.79.14/v2/vendors',
    params={
        'address':  '123 Main St Newark NJ',
        'radius':   25,
        'category': 'PLB',
        'limit':    10,
    },
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here'},
)
data = resp.json()
print(f"Found {data['total']} vendors near {data['search_center']['formatted_address']}")

          

        


        
        

          
Score Tiers

          
Each vendor receives a composite score (0–100) based on licensing, insurance, BBB rating, years in business, and customer reviews. The score is bucketed into a letter grade.

          

            A — 80–100 · Excellent
            B — 65–79 · Good
            C — 50–64 · Average
            D — 35–49 · Below avg
            F — 0–34 · Poor
          

        


        
        

          
Rate Limits & Limits

          

            
• 5 API keys per developer account

            
• 50 results max per request (use page for pagination)

            
• 200 miles max radius per request

            
• Rate limiting will be introduced in a future release. Please avoid more than 10 requests/second.
